thesis: The episode introduces André Bourbonnais, the managing director at BlackRock and global head of its newly launched long-term private capital business, highlighting his 30 years of experience in private markets including roles at CDPQ, CPPIB, and PSP Investments. The conversation explores the creation of BlackRock's new fund starting from a clean sheet, discussing the traditional private equity playbook and how permanent capital alters financial structures, business strategies, and return drivers.
